# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome girl with a brilliant complexion, large bright-blue eyes, and curly brown hair. She has a plump, showy figure and wears her hair dressed up when she goes to town. She considers herself grown up and likes to wear long skirts.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoys the pleasant things in life frankly. She is rather sentimental, highly emotional, and inclined to be hysterical when stressed. She is obsessed with the idea of having beaus, constantly talking about boys and the compliments they pay her.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Goals

- To have many beaus and a gay time before settling down in marriage  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## History

Ruby attended the Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her friends, participating in schoolroom gossip and playground games. She joined the Avonlea school concert as a performer in dialogues and tableaux, and later became a member of the girls' Story Club, writing overly sentimental stories. Along with Anne and other classmates, she studied under Miss Stacy for the Queen's Academy entrance examinations and successfully passed. During her year at Queen's in Charlottetown, she pursued a Second Class teacher's license and was noted as the handsomest girl of her year. After graduating, she secured a position as the schoolteacher at Carmody.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)_
